name: skeleton-reveal
title: Skeleton Reveal
description: Wraps real content and swaps a placeholder for it with a cross-fade. The content is always laid out, so nothing shifts when it arrives.

props.name: loading
props.description: While true the placeholder shows; when it turns false the content fades in.

props.name: children
props.description: The real content. It is always laid out, so the box never changes size.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Custom placeholder (build it from SkeletonBar). Defaults to a few grey lines.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root element.
